text.config.nicknameseverywhere.title: NicknamesEverywhere Configuration
text.config.nicknameseverywhere.option.m: The maximum length of a nickname. Set to 0 for no limit.
text.config.nicknameseverywhere.option.a: If enabled, players can use placeholder api formatting in their nicknames
If enabled, all players can set their own nicknames. If disabled, only operators can set nicknames.
